decisions.reason: The lever handle family stayed on the website through 2019 while three sibling handles were pruned, which marks it as a surviving core line; the tooling and catalogue investment and its fit with the firm's main handle business argue for continuing it.

This design also survived the 2019 pruning of the handle range, so management has already chosen it once over the dropped designs; that earlier choice and the sunk design costs favour keeping it, even though handle designs are fairly easy to rotate out.

The L700 electronic access system was publicly promoted as unique on the market, rebranded with the 'Pro' name in 2019, and is central to the firm's strategic move into electronic access, so heavy R&D investment and visible commitment make continuing it highly likely.
